data.name: Tejraj
data.gender_notes: Tejraj is used as a male name in Hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Tejraj is a Sanskrit name for a boy, meaning 'Ruler of Fire'. This name is derived from two Sanskrit words: 'Tej' which means 'Fire' and 'Raj' which means 'Ruler'. It is a powerful and authoritative name, reflecting the strength and wisdom of those who bear it. The name Tejraj carries the meaning “Ruler of Fire” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Hindu tradition and is also used in Sanskrit. Parents who choose Tejraj usually hope their child will grow to embody ruler of fire and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Tejraj is a spiritual name that signifies the inner power and strength of an individual. It represents the ability to harness the energy of the universe and use it to overcome challenges and achieve success.
data.etymology: Tejraj belongs to the Hindu linguistic tradition and is used in Hindu naming. Its recorded meaning is “Ruler of Fire.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Tejraj total 1, giving a life-path number of 1. Number 1 is linked with Sun and with the qualities of leadership, independence and initiative.

data.cultural_impact: The name Tejraj carries a rich cultural heritage in Hinduism, where fire is often considered a purifying and transformative element. Tejraj can be seen as representing the fiery spirit of warriors or leaders who boldly face challenges and lead their people towards progress and prosperity. In Hindu mythology, fire gods like Agni are revered and their energies invoked during rituals for purification, transformation, strength, and victory.
data.spiritual_significance: From a spiritual perspective, the name Tejraj represents the mastery of one's inner fire, the passion and determination that drives each individual to overcome challenges and continually evolve on their spiritual journey. It also symbolizes the inner light of Brahman (the ultimate reality) burning within every being. Moreover, Tejraj can be seen as a reminder of the transformative power of the discipline, focus, and inner strength that helps us transcend our limitations and strive towards our highest potential.
data.spiritual_symbolism: Tejraj signifies the one who wields the radiant, celestial energy of the sun within their being. It is a name for those who embody the fiery passion, illuminating wisdom, and courageous spirit of the divine sun god, Surya.

historical_references.reference: Tejraj was a famous Jain Tirthankara of the 23rd cycle of time, also known as the 'Jina of Victory'. The name Tejraj means 'the king of power or energy'.
Tejraj is also the name of a king in Hindu mythology, who was a grandson of the god Indra and a great warrior. He is known for his valor and is often depicted riding an elephant named Airavata.
